name: Florence-2-base
notes: Lightweight 230M parameter vision-language foundation model from Microsoft. Accepts RGB image + <VQA> prompt. Runnable on CPU and GPU. General-purpose pretrained VLM before domain fine-tuning.

name: GenericVLMOrchestrator
notes: Hosted foundation VLM API invoked with prompt engineering; not domain adapted.

name: ClassicalSpectralCaptionerBaseline
notes: Procedural baseline inspecting band count, albedo distribution, and CRS.

name: google/owlvit-base-patch32
notes: Open-vocabulary zero-shot object detector and visual grounding foundation model based on ViT-B/32. General-purpose pretrained detector (not remote-sensing fine-tuned). Runnable on CPU (~2-4GB RAM) and GPU (~2GB VRAM). Gracefully falls back to ClassicalBaselineGrounder when weights are not mounted.

name: ClassicalBaselineGrounder
notes: Classical spectral thresholding and connected component contour detection.

name: PixelDifferenceChangeBaseline
notes: Pixel-level grayscale spectral differencing with spatial overlap checking.

name: BIT-CD
notes: Bitemporal Image Transformer (ResNet-18 Siamese CNN backbone + Transformer decoder) for remote sensing surface change detection. Pretrained on LEVIR-CD/WHU-CD. Runnable on CPU (~2GB RAM) and GPU (~1GB VRAM). Gracefully falls back to PixelDifferenceChangeBaseline when weights are not mounted.

name: EvidenceGroundedChangeVQA
notes: Synthesizes change reasoning strictly grounded in difference metrics.

name: OpticalSARVisualizationBaseline
notes: Dual-modality visual composite with empirical backscatter intensity slicing.

name: OpticalSARJointAnalysisProvider
notes: Cross-modal calibrated joint analysis with separate normalization and decibel (dB) scaling.

name: BIFOLD-BigEarthNetv2-0/resnet50-s2-v0.2.0
notes: Official Sentinel-2 ResNet-50 multi-label land-cover classification model pre-trained on the refined BigEarthNet v2.0 (reBEN) dataset. Accepts 10 Sentinel-2 bands (B02-B12) normalized with reBEN channel statistics, resized to 120x120, and predicts 19 CORINE Land Cover classes via multi-label sigmoid outputs.
